visual_action: A still photograph of Kamala Harris being sworn in as Vice President is used as the background. Her right hand is raised. A man in a mask stands next to her, holding a bible. Superimposed over the lower half of the image is a video clip showing a close-up of Vince McMahon's face. He looks serious, then his eyes well up with tears and he looks down, appearing to be overcome with emotion.

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: She is the subject of the background photo, shown being sworn in, and the on-screen text refers to 'the first woman sworn in as vice president'.

cast.name: Roy Blunt
cast.evidence: He is visible in the background of the inauguration photograph, as identified by face-ID.

cast.name: Douglas Emhoff
cast.evidence: He is shown holding the bible for Kamala Harris during her swearing-in ceremony, a role implied by the context of the event.

on_screen_text.text: "tell us what it felt like to see the first woman sworn in as vice president"

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue in the video.
audio_music: A slow, solemn, and emotional orchestral track ('Face the Music' by Everett Dejean) plays throughout the clip, accentuating the emotional reaction depicted on screen.
editing_pacing: The video uses a static background image with a video clip superimposed on it. The superimposed clip is a slow close-up on a man's face.
manipulation_or_satire: A video clip of Vince McMahon's face is superimposed over a photograph of Kamala Harris at her inauguration. The clip is placed over her lower body, creating the visual effect of his head being on her body to form a meme.
central_claim: The inauguration of Kamala Harris as the first female Vice President was a deeply emotional and historic moment.
intended_effect: To evoke feelings of pride and emotional resonance regarding Kamala Harris's historic achievement, using a popular meme to represent an overwhelming emotional reaction.
